competencies.name: Shipping LLM products
competencies.posting_quote: You will ship LLM-powered features from prototype to production.

competencies.name: Ownership and communication
competencies.posting_quote: You own problems end to end and explain trade-offs clearly.

competencies.posting_quote: You measure quality with evals and keep latency and cost under control.

evidence.text: Built Verse, a macOS meeting assistant: a Swift app plus a Python brain that streams Claude answers to a notch card while the call is running.

sources.quote: brain: hedged streaming lanes for S/F/D routes

evidence.text: At Lantern, cut invoice entry time from 11 minutes to 2 minutes per document by adding an LLM extraction step with a human review screen.

sources.quote: Reduced invoice entry from 11 to 2 minutes

evidence.text: Published TrailHead, an iOS running and cycling app, on the App Store; wrote the backend and ran 4 ad experiments.

questions.text: Tell me a bit about yourself and what brought you to this role.
Describe a time you took an LLM feature from prototype to production.
How would you keep latency and cost under control in a streaming LLM feature?

c1.3: Shipped something, vague on production concerns.
c1.5: Prototype to production with named trade-offs and results.

c2.5: Owns outcomes and explains trade-offs crisply.

c3.5: Evals, latency and cost with numbers.
